label: buchouhou
title_raw: 不調法 or 無調法 [ぶちょうほう] (buchouhou)
title: 不調法 or 無調法
meaning_example: (1)ainiku osake ha buchouhou deshite - I must apologize but I don't drink (2) karaoke wo utatte agerareru to ii n desuga, ainiku buchouhou na mono desu.　If I could sing karaoke to you I would but sorry unfortunately I can't.

sections.text:
不調法 or 無調法 [ぶちょうほう] (buchouhou)
    Meaning: A rudeness or blunder, carelessness 
    Example: (1)ainiku osake ha buchouhou deshite - I must apologize but I don't drink (2) karaoke wo utatte agerareru to ii n desuga, ainiku buchouhou na mono desu.　If I could sing karaoke to you I would but sorry unfortunately I can't.
    JLPT Level: 1
    Category: grammar
    Author: kadoka66
